prompt: People tell me using this app is a slog but nobody can say exactly why. Work out where the pain is getting from opening a project to a task running, rank what to fix first, and give me numbers I can keep so I can tell whether a fix helped. Save your work.
assertions: The saved work records numbers for the journey that can be measured again after a fix, including a count of steps taken against the steps the person actually needed.
The report names the restart needed before the newly added project opens as its own problem.
The report names the generic 'Something went wrong. Please try again.' error shown when Start fails as its own problem and ranks it among the most costly.
The report treats the detour from the task composer to Settings and the per-project 'Use in this project' step as two separate problems.
The report names both the Refresh needed to see the new task and the internal IDs shown in the Running status as problems.
The report names 'Check connection' having to be pressed before the per-project switch appears as a problem.
The report gives a single total friction score of 16 or more and calls the journey broken.
The fixes are ordered by how many points they remove, and the report states the points each one covers.

The weights match the measure: the restart Progress (8), the generic error Way forward (10), the Settings detour Place (5), 'Use in this project' in Settings Search (3), and Check connection, Refresh and the internal IDs Attention (2) each.
